sloka: पांसु रूषित सर्वान्गः स्रस्त न्यस्त भुज द्वयः ।स्वप्स्यसे गाम् समाश्लिष्य दुर्लभाम् प्रमदाम् इव ॥३-३०-७॥
transliteration: pāṁsu rūṣita sarvāngaḥ srasta nyasta bhuja dvayaḥ ।svapsyase gām samāśliṣya durlabhām pramadām iva ॥3-30-7॥

translations.english: With all your limbs covered with dust, both the arms dropped down and stretched out on the ground, you will sleep as though hugging the earth, like embracing a rare woman.
